description: This file defines utility functions and data structures related to instance name validation, device name parsing, and configuration path retrieval within the 'cuttlefish' namespace for the Android Open Source Project. It declares functions for validating and breaking device names, generating error messages, and computing set intersections. It also includes template functions for intersecting sets.

classes.name: DeviceName
classes.description: Structure representing a parsed device name with separate group and per-instance names.

methods.name: GetCuttlefishConfigPath
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration path for Cuttlefish based on the provided home directory.

methods.name: LocalDeviceNameRule
methods.description: Generates a local device name based on a group name and instance name.

methods.name: IsValidInstanceName
methods.description: Checks if a token conforms to the valid instance name pattern.

methods.name: IsValidGroupName
methods.description: Checks if a token conforms to the valid group name pattern.

methods.name: IsValidDeviceName
methods.description: Checks if a token conforms to the valid device name pattern.

methods.name: BreakDeviceName
methods.description: Splits a device name into its group and per-instance components.

methods.name: GenerateTooManyInstancesErrorMsg
methods.description: Creates an error message indicating the number of instances exceeding a limit.

methods.name: Intersection
methods.description: Computes the intersection of sets, supporting multiple containers.
